purpose: MaskGate: local masking and restoration around checked remote LLM requests.

modules.name: HTTP boundary
modules.responsibility: Authentication, tenant principal, body/rate limits, production settings and routes.

modules.name: Detection and policy
modules.responsibility: One detector contract at ingress, wire and output; bounded canonicalization, risk and policy.

modules.name: Terminal boundaries
modules.responsibility: Inspect final serialized bytes and untrusted output; share encoded-view budgets.

modules.name: Orchestration and providers
modules.responsibility: Adapters translate the supported subset. Transports send sealed bytes and bound responses.

modules.name: Mapping and conversation state
modules.responsibility: Single-process RAM vault, principal isolation, restoration authorization, TTL and capacity.

modules.name: Local media and diagnostic UI
modules.responsibility: Bounded local media sanitization; React exposes the real masking path in local mode.

providers.OpenAI-compatible Chat: Runtime: non-stream and buffered strict streaming
providers.Gemini generateContent: Runtime: Chat-compatible ingress, converted provider output
